The fallback has a plausible robustness gap: after masked HLLE repair fails, clearing the masks and setting spatial order1 restores HLLD everywhere. This is not a global first-order HLLE safety update.

First inspect the restored state and failing-stage energy balance. If the restored state is admissible, compare all-face donor-cell HLLE and conservative global-speed LLF from that identical state. Neither guarantees multidimensional pressure positivity when the required discrete divergence constraint fails. [Wu & Shu](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1807.11467)

Cleaning-energy accounting does not eliminate divergence-driven pressure forcing. Powell, Janhunen and entropy-consistent GLM source formulations change the finite-divergence equations and require separate validation. [Derigs et al.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1711.06269v3)

Evidence, assumptions and frozen-source hashes are in `observations/glm_positivity_audit.txt/json`. No code changes or GPU jobs.
